init_locobot_base: initialize a LoCoBotBase instance with configs and an ILQR or proportional controller for robot navigation
go_to_absolute: move the robot base to an absolute world frame pose using go_to_absolute with optional map and smooth flags
go_to_relative: move the robot base to a pose relative to its current position using go_to_relative with close_loop control
track_trajectory: command the robot base to track a sequence of XYT states using track_trajectory with optional control inputs
get_state: retrieve the robot base pose as an XYT list from odometry or Visual-SLAM using get_state
